A NOTE ON THE DIALECT

There’s more than one way
to sound like Hyderabad.

You’ll learn shared Urdu/Hindi alongside local forms like hau, nakko, and kaiku. We explain where they fit, who to use them with, and when to let your family’s usage lead.
